description_expanded:
NatureWalk in Seagrove!

.5 miles to San Juan Public Beach Access, walk or bike the Lilly Lane Beach Trail!

3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths

2 community pools!

Point Washington State Forest has miles of walking and biking trails

Smart TVs in every bedroom

Gas grill

3 bikes!

4-star restaurants

Fun eateries and boutiques in Seaside

30A Wildflower Cottage by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Wow! 30A’s newest neighborhood is gorgeous and holds the secret to your next dream vacation. Welcome to 30A Wildflower Cottage in NatureWalk at Seagrove Beach. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath retreat has everything you need for a fun and relaxing getaway, including a Solaris Whole House PCO Air Purifier System. Step into bright, airy, living spaces that feel like home. The open kitchen comes fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, all the cooking essentials, and a Keurig for your morning coffee fix. The large island has barstool seating, and the kitchen flows into a spacious living and dining area that’s perfect for gathering. On the first floor, the primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with its private bathroom just steps away from the main living area. Upstairs, there’s a cozy den that doubles as a second living room, great for kids or anyone who wants a little extra space. The second primary bedroom features a king bed and an en-suite with a double vanity.

There’s also a fun bunk room for the kids, which shares a hallway bath. Biking and walking trails are waiting to be explored at NatureWalk, tucked within the beautiful Point Washington State Forest. Also bicycle friendly, Seaside is just 2.5 miles away, where dining and shopping options abound. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bath - 1901 sq ft - Smart TVs in every bedroom - Solaris Whole House PCO Air Purifier System - Limited onsite parking for two vehicles/no garage access (No on-street parking allowed) - Gas grill - 2 community pools - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included Overnight: - King bed in 1st floor primary bedroom; bath, Smart TV - King bed in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath; Smart TV - Twin bunk beds in 2nd floor guest room; shared hall bath; Smart TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST. Please note that the NatureWalk community requires a 6-night minimum stay. - If you book 4 nights, your reservation will be extended to 6 nights, and the additional 2 nights will be provided at no extra cost. - If you book 5 nights, your stay will be extended to 6 nights, with the additional night provided at no extra cost.
